context.why: The safety property the whole workflow rests on. The uploader chooses their completed template, the portal reads it and reports what importing it would do, and NOTHING reaches the database until they have seen that report and confirmed it. The reader and its checking mode already exist from the foundational phase; this story is the page around them, the report they read, and the confirmation that writes. An import that writes first and reports afterwards cannot be undone by anyone without database access, which is why there is no way to skip the check.
context.environment: Python 3.13 via Poetry, virtualenv already synced. Prefix commands with `poetry run`. Tests: `poetry run pytest`. Lint gate: `poetry run pre-commit run -a`, never raw ruff. A development server is already running from this worktree on 0.0.0.0:8001 with the autoreloader; do not start another and do not stop it.
spec_sections: spec.md User Story 3 and its six acceptance scenarios
spec.md Edge Cases (the stale report, the double confirmation)
prior_decisions: D5: the check cannot be turned off. No setting, no parameter, no URL writes without checking first. T024 is the test that keeps it that way and it must fail if a future view bypasses the check.

D6: confirmation RE-RUNS the check against the stored file rather than trusting the report the user saw, then writes in the same transaction. The assessment's state is the idempotency key, so a second confirmation is a no-op redirect. One mechanism covers both the double submission and the stale report.

D7/D12: never pass dry_run=True to either import resource. import_ghfdb_template(check_only=True) already does the right thing — both passes run for real inside the outer transaction and it is rolled back. specs/004-import-upload-template/decisions.md D16 has the empirical proof of why the naive version refuses every file.
D7: every submitted file is kept. SubmittedFile is a row per submission, and Review.current reads the most recent.
D16/#367: rendering the shared page chrome for a signed-in user raises when DEBUG=False. Scope granted-path tests as US-1 and US-2 did.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given an assessment in DESCRIBED and a valid completed template, When the file is uploaded, Then a SubmittedFile row exists, the reader ran with check_only=True, the report is rendered, and the dataset still holds no data. And When a file that is not a spreadsheet is chosen, Then the form refuses it before the reader sees it, reusing the extension validator already on project/ghfdb/forms.py::GHFDBImportForm.

Given a clean file's report, When the page renders, Then it names how many sites and how many determinations would be created and how many existing records would be updated, asserted against the rendered HTML.

Given a checked file, When the uploader confirms, Then the check is re-run against the stored file and the data is written in that same transaction, imported_at is stamped on the submission, and the counts written match the counts the report named.
Given a confirmation already accepted, When the same confirmation is posted again, Then nothing is written twice and the response is a redirect to the result.

Given the application's URL configuration, When the test enumerates every route that can write, Then each one is proven to go through the check first. Reinstate a bypass and confirm this test fails before accepting it as passing — this is the test for SC-002.

rituals: Read specs/005-assessment-upload-workflow/spec.md User Story 3, plan.md and data-model.md before writing anything.
Read project/ghfdb/importers.py and project/ghfdb/report.py — the reader and the report builder already exist and are tested; you are calling them, not rewriting them.
Read specs/004-import-upload-template/decisions.md D16 before touching anything to do with dry runs.
Read project/review/views.py and tests/test_review/test_views.py to follow the shape US-1 and US-2 established.
Confirm HEAD equals the verified_base commit before starting.
Work in thin slices: each slice leaves the suite green and is committed before the next begins.
prohibitions: Stage explicit paths only. Never `git add -A` or `git add .` — this worktree is shared with a running development server and the orchestrator.
Do not stop, restart or start a development server. One is already running on port 8001 with the autoreloader.
Never pass dry_run=True to either import resource.
Do not add a way to skip the check — no checkbox, no query parameter, no separate write route.
Never weaken or delete a test you did not author in this story.
Do not build the failure report's presentation, the visibility rules or the curator queue. Those are US-4 onward.
Do not attempt to fix the DEBUG=False chrome defect; it is raised upstream as django-mvp/django-mvp#367.
Do not add any new dependency.
Do not push, open pull requests or comment on GitHub. Commit locally only.
Never judge layout or appearance from a screenshot and never claim a visual result is correct on that basis.
